web.scope: Checked on 15.11.2026 while researching speech synthesis models: Hugging Face metadata, licence files, discussions, mlx-audio issues. Reddit unreadable. Not researched further.
web.summary: Fine-tune of VibeVoice; open release without cloning, voices speed up past about 15 s and stop near 40 s; watermark on all output; German babble bug in mlx-audio fixed 05.11.2026.
web.verdict: No cloning in the open release; speeds up on long texts

comments.text: Not a usable release: cloning promised in February, still missing in May; voices speed up past about 15 s and stop near 40 s ([HF #8, 06.02–30.05.2026](https://huggingface.co/kugelaudio/kugelaudio-0-open/discussions/8)).

Works great in French, cloning very good with the Space code; long texts accelerate, generate sentence by sentence ([kugelaudio-open #1, 16.01.2026](https://github.com/Kugelaudio/kugelaudio-open/issues/1)).
